about_the_game:
Getting in was the easy part.

You squeezed under the door, tiptoed between the sleeping guard's legs, climbed up into the rafters, and scoured the room. That's when you spied it: The Treasure. Weeks of covert observation had paid off.

Now what?

You aren't big enough to lift it. And there's only one way out. But there's sooo much junk in the way. Someone needs to teach these greedy hoarders about Spring cleaning!

So make a plan... Or don't... And start pushing!

And don't feel too bad about it. They're the real crooks (plus one kleptomaniac bird!), not you. You're just a Pocket Thief!

KEY FEATURES:

  • Lots to see (and steal!):
    5 hand-drawn, themed stages; each filled with a variety of interesting objects and sweet, sweet loot.

  • Plenty to get your mitts on:
    60 hand-crafted puzzles that gradually become more complex, including 10 bonus levels with bonus rewards, and a random level selector.

  • Slide willy-nilly or puzzle efficiently:
    Take fewer moves to improve your rating, and attain maximum efficiency; if that's your thing.

  • Decorate your Secret Hideout:
    Complete bonus levels to unlock trophies and proudly display them in your (not so) secret hideout.

  • Simple controls:
    Play with mouse only, or 'out-of-the-box' on Steam Deck. Click, hold, and drag.

  • Listen to your surroundings:
    The music changes to match the setting as you progress through the stages.

  • Limited skips:
    Start with a couple of skips and replenish your stock by completing other levels.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-core or other low-end processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Storage: 100 MB available space

short_description: Drag your way to becoming a master thief, as you steal from the rich, and keep a little something for yourself; in this criminally fun 2D puzzle game. Avoid barriers and slide other obstructions thoughtfully away until you can successfully guide the loot out of each maze-like level.
